body: claimed: issue-worker-high (Opus) · 2026-11-13T15:51Z · worktree/branch issue/1431-wasm-file-commands · plan: inventory of native dialogs; save/save-as/posted program via browser download; disable the rest on wasm with a reason; open picker left to PR #1314 (fork branch, not stacked)

Inventory: every native file/folder dialog in the UI, and what the wasm32 build does with it today (main at 936172d8a).

All pickers go through `crates/ui/src/file_dialog.rs` (`FileDialog`). On wasm32 its `pick_file` / `save_file` / `pick_folder` log "dialog is not available in the browser build yet (#31): treated as cancelled" and return `None`, so every row below is a silent no-op in the browser today (the log is not on screen). The `*File(path)` script arms fail by name on wasm because `std::fs` answers Unsupported there.

| Command / control | Where | Dialog | Browser today | This PR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Model (ribbon, Ctrl+O) | `OpenModelDialog`, state.rs `pick_mesh_file` | open | no-op | darkened, tip + status: needs the browser file picker (#31 / PR #1314) |
| Open project (ribbon, Ctrl+Shift+O) | `OpenProjectDialog`, `pick_project_file` | open | no-op | same |
| Open recent (ribbon lists) | `OpenRecent` | none (fs) | fails on fs | refused: the browser keeps no recent files |
| Save (Ctrl+S) | `SaveProjectDialog`, `save_project_dialog` | save | no-op | **downloads** `<name>.camproj`, marks clean |
| Save As (Ctrl+Shift+S) | `SaveProjectAsDialog` | save | no-op | **downloads** under a prompted name |
| Unsaved prompt: Save | unsaved.rs `resolve_unsaved` | save | no-op, document kept | **downloads**, then goes on |
| Post (ribbon, Ctrl+P) | `PostProgramDialog` -> state_per_op.rs | save | no-op | **downloads** the gated `.nc`; refusal window as on desktop |
| Post, one file per operation | `PostProgramDialog` (per-op) | folder | no-op | darkened, tip + status: needs a folder; switch Output |
| Load post (.cps) | `SelectPostDialog`, `pick_post_file` | open | no-op | button greyed with reason |
| Load machine (.mch) / Load other | `LoadMachineDialog`, `pick_machine_file` | open | no-op | buttons greyed with reason |
| Theme dropdown "Browse..." | `SelectThemeDialog`, `pick_theme_file` | open | no-op | refused on the status line (row has no disabled state) |
| Import fixture (page button, tree menu) | `ImportFixtureDialog`, `pick_mesh_file` | open | no-op | page button greyed; menu row refused on status line |
| Fixture library save / insert | `FixtureLibrarySaveDialog` / `InsertDialog` | none (user folder) | fails on fs | refused on status line |
| Tool library export / import | state_tool_library.rs | save / open | no-op | buttons greyed with reason |
| Tool body import | state_tool_body.rs `import_tool_body_dialog` | open | no-op | button greyed with reason |
| Setup sheet export | `SetupSheetDialog`, `save_sheet_dialog` | save | no-op | button greyed (export not a download yet) |
| Tool list export | `ToolListExportDialog` | save | no-op | button greyed (export not a download yet) |
| Stock STL export | `ExportStockDialog`, `save_stl_dialog` | save | no-op | button greyed (export not a download yet) |

Open paths stay owed to PR #1314 (a contributor's fork branch; this work is not stacked on it). The other exports as downloads are filed as a follow-up.

Partial: Save, Save As and Post download in the browser; every other file command is greyed or refused with its reason. Open paths stay owed to PR #1314, the exports to #1437, so the PR says Refs, not Fixes. Screenshots of the browser build are owed for the maintainer.
